paragraphs: Nekosa. R' Yehudah ben Nekosa, a Tanna; [Yoma 18a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.18a.14).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked baraita names Rabbi Yehudah ben Nekosa among the authorities discussing the High Priest’s food on the eve of Yom Kippur.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2728&lang=en) gives Nekosa or Nekova and names Rabbi Yehudah as his son.
